시편 94:1.content: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

시편 94:2.content: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

시편 94:3.content: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

시편 94:4.content: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

시편 94:5.content: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.

시편 94:6.content: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

시편 94:7.content: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

시편 94:8.content: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

시편 94:9.content: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

시편 94:10.content: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

시편 94:11.content: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

시편 94:12.content: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;

시편 94:13.content: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

시편 94:14.content: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

시편 94:15.content: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

시편 94:16.content: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

시편 94:17.content: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

시편 94:18.content: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.

시편 94:19.content: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

시편 94:20.content: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

시편 94:21.content: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

시편 94:22.content: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

시편 94:23.content: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.
